C1250.title: Haikou Police Crack SMS Verification Code Prepaid Card Money Laundering Case
C1250.summary: In November 2020, Haikou police uncovered an underground criminal operation and arrested intermediary 'card merchant' Chen. Chen used SMS verification codes provided by Tian to purchase prepaid cards for money laundering. The case involved a large-scale code-receiving platform that used illegally obtained verification codes to buy prepaid cards, enabling fund transfer and cleansing.
